Q.name: Handshake
Q.title: Template:Data Renata Glasc/Handshake
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Handshake|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Renata Glasc |skill = Q |icon = Renata Glasc Handshake.png |blurb = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Renata Glasc|Renata}} fires a hook in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and briefly {{tip|root|roots}} them. She can recast the ability while the target is rooted. |blurb2 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Renata''' {{tip|airborne|knocks}} the target in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit. If the thrown target is a {{tip|champion}}, enemies hit are briefly {{tip|stun|stunned}}. |description = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Renata''' fires a hook in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|root|roots}} them for 1 second, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.

If the {{tip|root}} was applied, '''Renata''' forms a {{tip|tether}} between her and the target for the same duration, causing '''Renata''' to become unable to declare attacks and have her {{as|movement speed}} '''reduced''' by {{as|30%|ms}}. |description2 = ''Handshake'' can be recast while the tether is active. |leveling = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 260}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}} |icon3 = Renata Glasc Handshake 2.png |description3 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Renata''' breaks the tether to {{tip|airborne|knock}} the target in the target direction, though not through terrain, dealing the same damage to enemies they pass through. If the thrown target is a {{tip|champion}}, all secondary targets hit are {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. |cooldown = 16 |cdstart = Starts post-effect if an enemy is hit, on-cast if not |cast time = {{fd|0.25}} |cost = 80 |costtype = Mana |range = {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|900|Missile range}}|{{tt|275|Recast throw range}}}} |width = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|140|Missile width}} |tether radius= {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 1200 |collision radius= |speed = {{tt|1450|Missile speed}} |queue time = {{dv|{{tt|{{fd|0.5}}|First cast}}|{{tt|{{fd|0.3}}|Recast}}}} |targeting = Direction |damagetype = magic |projectile = true |affects = Self, Enemies |spelleffects = special |onhiteffects = |spellshield = special |callforhelp = |notes = * Applies {{tip|spell damage}} to the primary target and {{tip|area damage}} to secondary targets. * ''Handshake's'' interaction between its tether and root: ** If the root is not applied, neither is the tether. ** The tether's duration lasts the same as the root duration, even if it is modified by {{tip|tenacity}}. ** If the root is removed, the tether is as well, but not vice versa. * {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the hook but not the recast's effects as the primary target. ** As a secondary target, the recast's effects will be blocked. * '''Renata''' may still move while the hook is in flight. ** Her facing direction is locked towards the target direction of the hook. * While the target is hooked, '''Renata's''' facing direction is considered to be in their direction and not in the one she is moving. * The {{as|{{sti|movement speed}}}} reduction stacks additively with other {{sti|{{as|movement speed}}}} bonuses. ** It is a negative bonus, not a {{tip|slow}}, and is thus not reduced by {{tip|slow resist}}. {{Effect at cast time start}} }}

W.name: Bailout
W.title: Template:Data Renata Glasc/Bailout
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Bailout|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Renata Glasc |skill = W |icon = Renata Glasc Bailout.png |blurb = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Renata Glasc|Renata}} grants herself or the target allied champion ramping {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} in addition to {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} toward enemies. ''Bailout's'' duration resets whenever the target scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion. |blurb2 = If the target would {{tip|death|die}} while ''Bailout'' is active, their health is set back to full but they suffer a {{as|true damage}} burn that would kill them over a short time. The target can stop the burn by scoring a {{tip|takedown}}. |description = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Renata''' infuses herself or the target allied champion with a chemtech formula for 5 seconds, granting the target {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while they are facing nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champions or minions, with both of the bonuses increasing in effectiveness by {{pp|key=%|type=seconds elapsed|0 to 100 for 21|0 to 5}}. ''Bailout's'' duration resets whenever the target scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion within 6 seconds of damaging them. |leveling = {{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|10 to 30}}% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 AP)}}|Maximum Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|10*2 to 30*2}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|1*2}}% per 100 AP)}}}} {{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|10 to 20}}% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 AP)}}|Maximum Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|10*2 to 20*2}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|1*2}}% per 100 AP)}}}} |description2 = If the target takes {{tip|death|fatal damage}} while ''Bailout'' is active, they are restored to {{as|100% of their '''maximum''' health}} but suffer a {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}} burn equal to {{as|10% of their '''maximum''' health}} every {{rutngt|0.25}} until they reach {{as|'''0''' health}}, during which ''Bailout's'' duration is reset every {{fd|0.25}} seconds. This effect may occur only ''once'' per application of ''Bailout'' while the target already has the buff and is not burning.

The burn will stop once the target scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion within 6 seconds of damaging them, setting their {{as|'''current''' health}} to {{as|20% of their '''maximum''' health}} immediately afterwards. |cooldown = {{ap|28 to 24}} |cdstart = on-cast |cast time = none |cost = 80 |costtype = Mana |target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 800 |effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|1300|Radius for movement speed towards enemies}} |width = |speed = |targeting = Unit |damagetype = |projectile = |affects = |spelleffects = |onhiteffects = |spellshield = |callforhelp = |flavorsound = [[File:Renata_Glasc_Original_SFX_W_hit_player.ogg]] ''Activation SFX'' |notes = * Damage taken in excess of the fatal damage taken does not apply to the target's health after it was restored. * The self-damage taken is considered {{tip|raw damage}} and is calculated based on the target's '''maximum''' health at the time of taking lethal damage. * ''Bailout's'' bonuses will not reset in effectiveness if its duration is refreshed. * ''Bailout'' takes priority over all {{tip|resurrection}} and {{tip|zombie state}} effects. * ''Bailout'' will stop refreshing its duration while the target is burning after 250 seconds have elapsed. * ''Bailout'' cannot be used on {{tip|clone|clones}} nor {{tip|zombie state|zombie state}} units. * If ''Bailout'' is cast on a target that is already burning from a previous ''Bailout'' cast, they can trigger a subsequent health restore as well as be inflicted with another burn. This may occur an infinite number of times as long as the target stays burning and does not reach 0 health. ** Casting ''Bailout'' on a target that already has the buff will only refresh the duration (without resetting the bonuses). * If the target takes fatal damage during ''Bailout'', upon destroying a turret while being targeted by it, they will receive their own [[Champion gold bounties#General|Shut-Down gold]] (specifically ignoring the ''base'' bounty) instead of being executed.{{bug|1}} }}
